newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere A up on foreign ownership move.
newsitem.headline: Solidere A up on foreign ownership move.

text.p: Solidere A shares hit a seven-month high of $12 on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday after the company said it planned to allow foreign investors and local institutions to buy its shares from October.
Solidere B shares were unchanged at $12, a price they hit on Wednesday for the second time since early January.

"News that the company will open up to foreigners will boost demand on the share as more Lebanese investors will want to secure strong positions before October when foreign investors come in as players," Georges Abou Jaoude, trading manager at Beirut finance house Financial Funds Advisors said.

Solidere's GDRs are trading at $15.6 on the London Stock Exchange. "This indicates foreign investors might want to buy heavily into what they view as an undervalued stock in Beirut which in turn would bring its price further up," Abou Jaoude said.
